interpretation: Fixed 2020–2024 five-year resident/household estimates, not 2024-only measurements or demographics of voters. Earlier populations may differ.

native_non_hispanic_pct.label: Non-Hispanic American Indian / Alaska Native alone residents

pacific_non_hispanic_pct.label: Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander alone residents

other_race_non_hispanic_pct.label: Non-Hispanic residents of some other race alone

multiracial_non_hispanic_pct.label: Non-Hispanic residents of two or more races

hispanic_pct.label: Hispanic / Latino residents of any race

noncitizen_pct.label: Residents who are not U.S. citizens

citizen_voting_age_population.label: U.S. citizens aged 18 and over (not registered or eligible voters)

cvap_age_18_29_pct.label: Citizens aged 18–29 as a share of citizens aged 18+

cvap_age_65_plus_pct.label: Citizens aged 65+ as a share of citizens aged 18+

bachelors_plus_pct.label: Adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher

graduate_degree_pct.label: Adults 25+ with a graduate or professional degree

less_than_high_school_pct.label: Adults 25+ without a high-school diploma or equivalent

high_school_only_pct.label: Adults 25+ with high-school diploma / GED as highest attainment

english_only_pct.label: Residents 5+ speaking only English at home

median_household_income.label: Median household income in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars

household_income_100k_plus_pct.label: Households with income of $100,000 or more

poverty_pct.label: People below the poverty level, among those with poverty status determined
source_universes: Population for whom poverty status is determined

unemployment_pct.label: Unemployed share of the civilian labor force aged 16+

labor_force_participation_pct.label: Residents 16+ in the labor force, including Armed Forces

homeownership_pct.label: Owner-occupied share of occupied housing units

renter_pct.label: Renter-occupied share of occupied housing units

median_gross_rent.label: Median monthly gross rent for renter-occupied units paying cash rent
source_universes: Renter-occupied housing units paying cash rent

median_home_value.label: Median value of owner-occupied housing units

married_couple_households_pct.label: Married-couple family households as a share of all households

living_alone_households_pct.label: One-person households as a share of all households

public_transit_commute_pct.label: Workers 16+ commuting by public transportation, excluding taxicab

manufacturing_employment_pct.label: Civilian employed residents 16+ in manufacturing
source_universes: Civilian employed population 16 years and over

agriculture_mining_employment_pct.label: Civilian employed residents 16+ in agriculture, forestry, fishing and hunting, and mining
source_universes: Civilian employed population 16 years and over

missing_policy: Null estimates are omitted from the scatterplot only. Counties remain selectable on the map. No imputation; margins of error are not drawn.
